# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 13 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** The Righteous and Sinners — Contrasting Fates

---

**13:1** Do not despise us, O God, when our soul cries out to thee
in affliction and misery.

**13:2** The right hand of the LORD is upon us as a shield;
the hand of the LORD is upon us for good.

**13:3** The rod of instruction of the LORD for the devout in reproof of love;
he leads them to live the life of God.

**13:4** The devout of the LORD will live by it forever;
the Paradise of the LORD, the trees of life, are his devout ones.

**13:5** Their planting is rooted forever;
they will not be plucked out all the days of the heavens.

**13:6** For the portion and inheritance of God is Israel.

**13:7** But not so with the sinners and the transgressors,
who love [only] the day of their companionship in sin;

**13:8** their delight is in the fleeting corruption,
and they do not remember God.

**13:9** For the ways of men are known before the LORD,
and he knows the secrets of the heart before they come to pass.

**13:10** Therefore their inheritance is Hades, darkness, and destruction;
and they will not be found on the day when the righteous obtain mercy.

**13:11** But the devout of the LORD will inherit life in gladness.

**13:12** Our life is in the love of God;
so we hope in him forever and ever.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Greek (Codex Vindobonensis). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
